title: Crash after landing left the base branch moved but the landing gate open
summary: Found by the crash_after_land kill-point and landing invariants in tests/test_orchestrator_state_machine.py (3 violations in 40 seeds, seeds 3009/3018/3035): decide() marked the gate approved and _land fast-forwarded main in memory, but the record was saved only afterwards, so after a crash the gate reappeared as open while main had already moved. Fixed in ee378ff8 (DEC-0020).
